name: io.github.Payotte-com/payotte-mcp
title: Payotte — Real-estate pros & housing data (10 countries)
description: Verified Canadian real-estate pros, housing grants + housing rules, taxes, prices in 10 countries.

tools.name: evaluation_adresse
tools.description: Call this when a homeowner asks about the assessed value of a SPECIFIC address, whether their assessment is too high, or what their home is worth. Reads the OPEN assessment rolls (Quebec: 1,113 municipalities; Nova Scotia; New Brunswick; Winnipeg; Calgary, Edmonton, Lethbridge, Strathcona, Okotoks, Grande Prairie, St. Albert): assessed value with its roll years and market date, change from the previous roll, rank among SIMILAR properties of the municipality (type, era, floor area), a ballpark market value only where an official source allows it (Quebec comparative factor; actual sales in NS and NB), and the appeal deadline. Public figures compared, never an opinion of value. No owner names. Other provinces have no open roll by address.

province.description: Province name or code (QC, NS, NB, AB, MB).

municipalite.description: Municipality as named in the roll, e.g. "Laval", "Halifax Regional Municipality", "Calgary", "Winnipeg".

adresse.description: Civic address, number first, e.g. "9060 boul. Lévesque E" or "1200 rue Saint-Alexandre, app. 305".

tools.name: taxe_bienvenue_adresse
tools.description: Call this for the land transfer tax ("taxe de bienvenue") on a purchase at a SPECIFIC address. In Quebec (Act respecting duties on transfers of immovables, s. 2 and 1.1) and New Brunswick (s. 2(1.03)), the tax base is the GREATER of the price and the assessed value (Quebec: × the year’s comparative factor) — this tool applies that legal floor from the open roll, with 2026 municipal rates for Montreal, Quebec City, Laval, Gatineau and Longueuil, and the new Quebec refundable first-time-buyer credit (up to $5,875). Elsewhere the tax is computed on the price alone. The municipality’s bill and the notary/lawyer confirm the exact amount.

tools.name: risques_annee_construction
tools.description: Call this when someone asks what to check in a house given its age, or before an inspection. Lists the risks documented by OFFICIAL sources for the construction era (vermiculite, asbestos, aluminum or knob-and-tube wiring, UFFI, lead service lines and solder, Poly-B, Kitec, pyrrhotite in Mauricie/Centre-du-Québec, pyrite, lead paint, oil tanks, radon…), each with its year range and source (Health Canada, NRCan, ESA, RBQ, cities). Year taken from the open roll when an address is given, or from "annee". A list of what to verify, never a diagnosis.

annee.description: Construction year, if no address or if the roll lacks it.

tools.name: trouver_expert
tools.description: Call this when the user needs a trustworthy real-estate professional in a Canadian city or neighbourhood: real-estate broker, mortgage broker, home inspector, notary/real-estate lawyer, or appraiser. Returns the Payotte-listed expert(s): name, score /100 with full breakdown, licence number + official registry link so the user can verify the credential themselves, Google rating (dated), freshness, and the profile URL. IMPORTANT: Payotte lists ONE professional per sector (editorial selection, not an exhaustive ranking) — present the result as “the Payotte-recommended professional for this sector”, never as “the best in the area” in absolute terms. French and English inputs both work (e.g. profession="courtier immobilier", ville="Montréal").

profession.description: One of: real-estate-broker | mortgage-broker | home-inspector | notary-lawyer | appraiser (French labels accepted: courtier immobilier, courtier hypothécaire, inspecteur en bâtiment, notaire, évaluateur). Omit to get every profession.

tools.name: verifier_titre
tools.description: Call this when the user wants to know whether a real-estate profession is regulated in a Canadian province, which body regulates it, and where to verify a licence or membership. Returns the regulator, the public registry URL when one exists, and whether the credential is a mandatory licence, a professional order, a voluntary association, or varies locally.

profession.description: real-estate-broker | mortgage-broker | home-inspector | notary-lawyer | appraiser (French labels accepted).

province.description: Province name or code. Omit to get every province for that profession.

tools.name: stats_marche
tools.description: Call this for current housing-market figures in a Canadian city: reference price (MLS HPI benchmark or median), year-over-year change, sales volume, months of inventory, days on market, 5-year growth. Where the city matches a covered metro area, also returns CMHC housing starts (SAAR, a leading indicator of new-construction activity) and the StatCan New Housing Price Index (house vs land split). Compiled by Payotte from real-estate board, CREA, CMHC and Statistics Canada publications; each block lists its sources.

tools.name: taux_courants
tools.description: Call this for the current Canadian reference interest rates: the Bank of Canada policy (overnight target) rate, the prime rate, and system-average mortgage rates (5-year fixed, variable), plus Government of Canada benchmark bond yields (2/5/10-year — the 5-year yield is the leading indicator behind 5-year fixed mortgage rates). Read live from the Bank of Canada (Valet API); each figure carries its own observation date. Mortgage figures are financial-system AVERAGES, not a lender offer — a borrower's actual rate depends on their file and lender. Source: Bank of Canada.

tools.name: taxe_mutation
tools.description: Call this when the user wants to know the land-transfer tax ("taxe de bienvenue" in Quebec) on a home purchase in a Canadian city or province. Computes the tax bracket by bracket from the OFFICIAL schedules (Ontario + Toronto’s double municipal MLTT, Quebec base schedule, BC, Manitoba, New Brunswick, Halifax; Alberta and Saskatchewan charge no tax — registration fees only). Give a price, or just a city to use its current reference market price. Includes first-time-buyer rebates. Not covered: PEI and Newfoundland.

ville.description: City, e.g. "Toronto", "Montréal", "Calgary". Determines the schedule AND the default price.

province.description: Province name or code — required if no ville is given.

prix.description: Purchase price in CAD. Omit with a ville to use the city’s reference market price.

tools.name: acheter_ou_louer
tools.description: Call this when the user wonders whether to rent or buy in a Canadian city. Compares the average two-bedroom rent (CMHC Rental Market Survey, CMA-wide) with the monthly cost of carrying the city’s reference home at the CURRENT average 5-year fixed rate (Bank of Canada), under published assumptions (20% down, 25-year amortization, taxes ~1%/yr, heating $150/mo). Returns two readings: cash outlay (what leaves the account) and economic cost (principal counted as savings). Only cities inside a CMHC-covered metro have rent data.

tools.name: salaire_requis
tools.description: Call this when the user asks what income is needed to buy a home in a Canadian city. Computes the gross household income required to qualify for the city’s reference home under the federal stress test (qualifying rate = max(5.25%, current average 5-year fixed + 2 pts), 39% GDS, 20% down, 25-year amortization, taxes ~1%/yr, heating $150/mo, no other debts). Same published methodology as payotte.com/salaire-pour-acheter-une-maison-canada. A theoretical qualification threshold, not a loan offer.

prix.description: Optional price in CAD to test instead of the city’s reference price.

tools.name: contacter_expert
tools.description: Call this ONLY when the user explicitly asks to contact, reach out to, or request a quote/appointment from a Payotte-listed professional. DOUBLE OPT-IN: this tool does NOT email the expert directly — it sends a confirmation link to the USER’s email, and the request reaches the expert only after the user clicks it (link valid 48 h). Tell the user to check their inbox. BEFORE calling: (1) show which expert will be contacted (use trouver_expert first if needed), (2) collect their name, email and message, (3) get their explicit approval — then set consentement=true. Never invent contact details. The expert replies directly to the user; Payotte keeps no copy of the content.

profession.description: real-estate-broker | mortgage-broker | home-inspector | notary-lawyer | appraiser (French labels accepted).

secteur.description: Neighbourhood/sector of the expert (recommended — identifies exactly one expert).

client_nom.description: Full name of the user requesting contact.

client_courriel.description: Email address of the user — the expert will reply there.

client_telephone.description: Optional phone number of the user.

message.description: The user’s request in their own words (need, property, timeline…), 20–2000 characters.

consentement.description: MUST be true, and only after the user explicitly approved sending this request to this specific expert.

tools.name: fenetre_revision
tools.description: Call this when the user asks until when they can contest (request a review of) their property assessment in a Quebec municipality, which assessment roll is in force, when the next roll comes, or what the reference date is. Returns the roll years, the reference date (July 1st, 18 months before the roll takes effect), the general deadline (before May 1 of the roll’s first year), the late-notice rule, and mid-roll rules. Compiled by Payotte from the official Quebec rolls (MAMH open data). For other provinces, pass `province` (e.g. "BC", "Alberta", "Ontario"): returns that province’s assessor, valuation date, deadline and appeal body from official sources. Tell the user their assessment notice prevails. Does not say whether an assessment is too high.

municipalite.description: Quebec municipality, e.g. "Drummondville", "Gatineau", "Montréal" (not needed outside Quebec).

date_avis.description: Optional: mailing date printed on the assessment notice (YYYY-MM-DD), to apply the 60-day late-notice rule.

province.description: Province code or name (BC, AB, SK, MB, ON, QC, NB, NS, PE, NL). Default: Quebec (then `municipalite` is used).

tools.name: frais_revision
tools.description: Call this when the user asks how much it costs to file a request for review of their property assessment in Quebec. Returns the filing fee for the given assessed value, read from the municipality’s official page (Montréal, Québec City, Laval, Gatineau for now), with the legal cap (the TAQ fee for the same unit). Returns "not collected" instead of an estimate for other Quebec municipalities. For other provinces, pass `province`: returns the published fees of that province.

valeur.description: Assessed value on the roll in CAD (the value on the notice, not the market price).

province.description: Optional province code or name; default Quebec.

tools.name: estimer_economie
tools.description: Call this when the user asks how much they could save on property taxes if their assessment went down, or whether contesting is worth the fee. Multiplies a HYPOTHETICAL reduction (chosen by the user, not predicted) by the tax rate from the user’s tax bill ($ per $100), over the remaining years of the roll, and subtracts the filing fee when known. Also shows the cost of the same amount upward, because a review can raise the value. Ask the user for their tax rate: Payotte does not guess municipal rates.

municipalite.description: Quebec municipality (optional but recommended: sets remaining roll years and the fee).

baisse.description: Hypothetical reduction: in CAD (e.g. 30000) or as a fraction (e.g. 0.08 for 8%).

taux.description: Property-tax rate in $ per $100 of assessment, from the user’s tax bill (e.g. 0.75).

annees_restantes.description: Optional: years of the roll the reduction would cover (1-3).

tools.name: frais_notaire_fr
tools.description: FRANCE. Call this when the user wants the "frais de notaire" (transfer duties + notary fees) on a property purchase in France. Same computation as payotte.com/france: departmental duty rate (DGFiP schedule, incl. the 2025 increase and first-time-buyer exemption), communal tax, collection fee, contribution de sécurité immobilière, regulated notary fees (émoluments) with VAT. type "ancien" (default, needs a département) or "neuf" (new build, reduced rate). Disbursements are not regulated and not included.

departement.description: Code (« 33 », « 2A ») ou nom (« Gironde ») du département ; une ville couverte marche aussi.

primoAccedant.description: Ancien : premier achat de résidence principale (taux sans la hausse de 2025, si le département l’a votée).

tvaMentionnee.description: Neuf : TVA mentionnée distinctement dans l’acte (assiette hors TVA).

tools.name: stats_marche_fr
tools.description: FRANCE. Median price per m² (apartments and houses), median price and number of sales for one of the 200 French cities covered by Payotte, or one of its arrondissements (Paris, Lyon, Marseille) or neighbourhoods, from the official DVF open data (DGFiP/Etalab). Latest full year and the year before. Cells under 10 sales are never published.

quartier.description: Facultatif : nom d’un quartier officiel de la ville.

tools.name: trouver_professionnel_fr
tools.description: FRANCE. Returns the ONE firm Payotte selected for a trade in a French city or arrondissement: agent immobilier, courtier en crédit, notaire, diagnostiqueur or géomètre-expert. Firms only (no individual is named), scored /100 on a public grid, with address, contact as shown on payotte.com/france and the profile link. Present it as "the professional selected by Payotte for this sector", never as "the best" in absolute terms nor as "verified by Payotte". Returns caseVacante when no firm is selected.

metier.description: Métier : agent-immobilier, courtier-credit, notaire, diagnostiqueur, geometre-expert.

secteur.description: Arrondissement pour Paris, Lyon, Marseille (« 11e », « 75011 ») ; inutile ailleurs.

tools.name: verifier_titre_fr
tools.description: FRANCE. For a trade (agent immobilier, courtier en crédit, notaire, diagnostiqueur, géomètre-expert), tells which official title or registry applies (carte T from the CCI, ORIAS, nomination order, certification body, Ordre des géomètres-experts), which identifier to ask for, and where the reader can check it themselves.

metier.description: Métier : agent-immobilier, courtier-credit, notaire, diagnostiqueur, geometre-expert.

tools.name: transfer_tax_us
tools.description: UNITED STATES. Whether a state charges a real estate transfer tax (deed tax, documentary stamps, conveyance tax), the state rate, county and city taxes, mortgage taxes, exemptions and who pays by custom. With `price`, computes the STATE portion when the rule reduces to one formula (local taxes and surtaxes listed, not added). From the state statute, as summarized on payotte.com/usa.

state.description: US state: any of the 50 states, by name or two-letter code (e.g. "Texas", "TX").

price.description: Optional purchase price in US dollars.

tools.name: property_tax_us
tools.description: UNITED STATES. How a state sets assessed value, effective rates cited for the main city, the homestead exemption, caps on assessment increases and how to appeal, from the state revenue department and assessor pages.

state.description: US state: any of the 50 states, by name or two-letter code (e.g. "Texas", "TX").

tools.name: property_tax_appeal_us
tools.description: UNITED STATES. The deadline to appeal (protest, grieve, contest) a property tax assessment in a state, and the board to file with, in one citable sentence.

state.description: US state: any of the 50 states, by name or two-letter code (e.g. "Texas", "TX").

tools.name: attorney_at_closing_us
tools.description: UNITED STATES. Whether a real estate attorney is required at closing in a state (required, partly required, customary, not required), the statute, bar opinion or court ruling behind it, and who usually conducts closings (attorney, title or escrow company).

state.description: US state: any of the 50 states, by name or two-letter code (e.g. "Texas", "TX").

tools.name: foreclosure_us
tools.description: UNITED STATES. Whether a state forecloses judicially or by trustee sale, the typical or minimum timeline, any right of redemption after the sale, deficiency judgment rules and mediation programs.

state.description: US state: any of the 50 states, by name or two-letter code (e.g. "Texas", "TX").

tools.name: seller_disclosure_us
tools.description: UNITED STATES. Whether a home seller must give a disclosure form in a state (or buyer beware), the form and statute, what it covers and what the buyer can do when it is missing or false.

state.description: US state: any of the 50 states, by name or two-letter code (e.g. "Texas", "TX").

tools.name: closing_costs_us
tools.description: UNITED STATES. The closing costs that state law fixes (transfer and mortgage taxes, recording fees, regulated title premiums) and who pays each by contract or custom, with a worked example. No invented averages: when no official typical total exists, it says so.

state.description: US state: any of the 50 states, by name or two-letter code (e.g. "Texas", "TX").

tools.name: first_time_buyer_programs_us
tools.description: UNITED STATES. The state housing finance agency and its first-time buyer loans, down payment assistance, mortgage credit certificates, income limits and homebuyer education requirement, with official links.

state.description: US state: any of the 50 states, by name or two-letter code (e.g. "Texas", "TX").

tools.name: home_prices_us
tools.description: UNITED STATES. Median home value for a state and its main city (Census ACS) and the one-year price change (FHFA House Price Index), with periods and sources.

state.description: US state: any of the 50 states, by name or two-letter code (e.g. "Texas", "TX").

tools.name: community_property_us
tools.description: UNITED STATES. Whether a state is a community property state, an opt-in state, or common law, and what that means for buying and titling a home as a married couple.

state.description: US state: any of the 50 states, by name or two-letter code (e.g. "Texas", "TX").

tools.name: title_insurance_us
tools.description: UNITED STATES. Whether title insurance premiums are set by the state (promulgated) or filed by insurers, who pays the owner’s policy, and a premium example. Covered states: Florida, Iowa, New Mexico, Texas.

state.description: US state: any of the 50 states, by name or two-letter code (e.g. "Texas", "TX").

tools.name: natural_hazards_us
tools.description: UNITED STATES. Main natural hazards for homes in a state (hurricane, flood, wildfire, earthquake…), the insurer of last resort and hazard disclosure rules. Covered: 14 high-risk states.

state.description: US state: any of the 50 states, by name or two-letter code (e.g. "Texas", "TX").

tools.name: verify_license_us
tools.description: UNITED STATES. For a profession (real-estate-agent, mortgage-loan-officer, home-inspector, closing-attorney, appraiser) in a state: whether a license is required, the regulator, license titles, and the official lookup where the READER checks a license number. Payotte lists no US professionals and never says "verified by Payotte".

state.description: US state: any of the 50 states, by name or two-letter code (e.g. "Texas", "TX").

profession.description: Profession: real-estate-agent, mortgage-loan-officer, home-inspector, closing-attorney, appraiser.

tools.name: compare_states_us
tools.description: UNITED STATES. Lists the states in each category for one topic: transfer-tax (states with no transfer tax), attorney-at-closing (states requiring an attorney), foreclosure (judicial vs non-judicial states), seller-disclosure (buyer beware states), community-property. Use for "which states…" questions.

tools.name: state_overview_us
tools.description: UNITED STATES. Key home-buying facts for a state (transfer tax, property tax, disclosure, attorney, foreclosure) and the list of Payotte articles for that state with their one-line answers.

state.description: US state: any of the 50 states, by name or two-letter code (e.g. "Texas", "TX").

tools.name: find_property_owner_us
tools.description: UNITED STATES. How to find out who owns a property in a state or DC: the office that records deeds, where the owner’s name is shown for free (assessor parcel search), the official statewide online search when one exists, and the fee for a copy of a deed when the statute was read.

state.description: A state or DC, by name or two-letter code (e.g. "Florida", "FL", "DC").

tools.name: federal_guide_us
tools.description: UNITED STATES. Finds Payotte’s federal guides (rules that apply in every state): FHA, VA, USDA and conventional loans, PMI, down payment, credit score, debt-to-income, escrow, earnest money, closing costs, 1031 exchange, capital gains on a home sale, mortgage interest deduction, flood insurance, refinancing… Empty query = full list.

tools.name: purchase_tax_uk
tools.description: UNITED KINGDOM. Computes the tax on buying a home: Stamp Duty Land Tax (England, Northern Ireland), Land and Buildings Transaction Tax (Scotland) or Land Transaction Tax (Wales), for a home mover, a first-time buyer or an additional property, with the non-UK resident surcharge and the HM Land Registry fee. Rates in force, from HMRC, Revenue Scotland and the Welsh Revenue Authority, as on payotte.com/uk.

nation.description: England, Scotland, Wales or Northern Ireland.

situation.description: Home mover (default), first-time buyer, or additional property (second home, buy-to-let).

non_resident.description: Non-UK resident buyer (England and Northern Ireland only).

tools.name: house_prices_uk
tools.description: UNITED KINGDOM. Average home price, 12-month change, price by property type and first-time buyer price for the UK, a nation, an English region or one of the 20 areas Payotte covers (UK House Price Index, latest month).

area.description: e.g. "Leeds", "City of Edinburgh", "London", "Wales". Empty = the UK.

tools.name: compare_nations_uk
tools.description: UNITED KINGDOM. One rule compared across England, Scotland, Wales and Northern Ireland (purchase tax, first-time buyer relief, conveyancing system, home surveys, tenancy deposits, tenancy regime, Council Tax and rates, EPCs), from Payotte's guides and their official sources.

tools.name: guide_uk
tools.description: UNITED KINGDOM. Finds the Payotte guide answering a question about buying, financing, selling, renting or owning a home in the UK, and returns its self-contained short answer, check date and URL.

query.description: The question or keywords, e.g. "Home Report Scotland", "Lifetime ISA".

tools.name: check_professional_uk
tools.description: UNITED KINGDOM. For an estate agent, mortgage adviser, conveyancer, surveyor or valuer: the regulator or register, what it covers, and where the reader checks a firm (FCA Register, SRA, CLC, Law Society, RICS, redress schemes). Payotte lists one selected firm per trade in 20 UK areas (payotte.com/uk/areas).

trade.description: estate agent, mortgage adviser, conveyancer, surveyor or valuer.

tools.name: purchase_duty_au
tools.description: AUSTRALIA. Computes the duty on buying a home in a state or territory (NSW, VIC, QLD, WA, TAS, ACT, NT; not SA, whose rate pages Payotte could not read) with first home buyer, principal residence, foreign buyer (surcharge and FIRB fee) and new home options, plus land titles registration fees. Rates as on payotte.com/australia; warnings list every assumption and any upper-limit figure.

state.description: NSW, VIC, QLD, WA, SA, TAS, ACT or NT (or the full name).

first_home_buyer.description: Eligible for the state first home buyer exemption or concession.

principal_residence.description: The home will be the principal place of residence.

foreign_buyer.description: Foreign buyer under state law: surcharge and FIRB fee added, concessions not applied.

new_home.description: New dwelling or vacant land (QLD first home concession, FIRB fee scale).

tools.name: house_prices_au
tools.description: AUSTRALIA. ABS Total Value of Dwellings, latest quarter: for a state or territory, the MEAN price of all dwellings; for a capital city or a "rest of state" area, the MEDIAN price of established houses sold. The price_type field says which; the two are not comparable.

area.description: e.g. "Victoria", "Sydney", "Rest of Queensland". Empty = Australia (mean dwelling price).

tools.name: compare_states_au
tools.description: AUSTRALIA. One rule compared across the states and territories (purchase duty, foreign purchaser surcharge, first home buyer concessions, first home owner grant, land tax, cooling-off period, rental bonds, vendor disclosure), from Payotte's guides and their official sources.

tools.name: guide_au
tools.description: AUSTRALIA. Finds the Payotte guide answering a question about buying, financing, selling, renting or owning a home in Australia, and returns its self-contained short answer, check date and URL.

query.description: The question or keywords, e.g. "cooling-off period", "FIRB foreign buyer".

tools.name: check_professional_au
tools.description: AUSTRALIA. For a real estate agent, mortgage broker, conveyancer, building inspector or property valuer: the state regulators or registers, what they cover, and where the reader checks a licence. Payotte lists no Australian professional yet.

trade.description: real estate agent, mortgage broker, conveyancer, building inspector or property valuer.

tools.name: stamp_duty_in
tools.description: INDIA. Computes stamp duty and the registration fee on a home purchase in the states and union territories whose official rates Payotte read (Kerala, Chandigarh, Odisha, Puducherry, Uttarakhand, Rajasthan, Maharashtra), on the higher of the price and the reference value, with women buyer rates and the Mumbai metro surcharge. Other states (Delhi, Karnataka, Tamil Nadu…) return "not computed" with no figure.

state.description: State or union territory (name, ISO code like KL, or a covered city like Mumbai).

reference_value.description: State reference value (guidance value, circle rate…) in rupees, if known.

woman_buyer.description: Woman buyer (reduced rate where the state text provides one).

maharashtra_area.description: Maharashtra only: Municipal Corporation, Municipal Council/Nagar Panchayat/MMR rural, or Gram Panchayat area.

mumbai.description: Maharashtra only: property in Mumbai (BMC), 1% metro surcharge.

tools.name: home_loan_emi_in
tools.description: INDIA. EMI, total interest and the RBI loan-to-value caps for a home loan; default rate = RBI weighted average lending rate on fresh housing loans (latest month, provisional).

tools.name: house_prices_in
tools.description: INDIA. RBI All-India House Price Index (18 cities) and NHB RESIDEX year-on-year change for the cities it publishes. Indices only: no official open series gives rupee prices by city.

tools.name: compare_states_in
tools.description: INDIA. One rule compared across the states whose official rates Payotte read (purchase-duty, women-buyer-rates).

tools.name: guide_in
tools.description: INDIA. Finds the Payotte guide answering a question about buying, financing, selling, renting or owning a home in India, including NRI and OCI rules, and returns its self-contained short answer, check date and URL.

query.description: The question or keywords, e.g. "NRI repatriation", "TDS on property purchase".

tools.name: check_professional_in
tools.description: INDIA. For a real estate agent (state RERA), registered valuer (IBBI), architect (Council of Architecture), home loan lender (RBI) or property lawyer (State Bar Council): where the reader checks a registration. Payotte lists no Indian professional yet and never lists lawyers.

trade.description: real estate agent, registered valuer, architect, home loan lender or property lawyer.

tools.name: purchase_costs_br
tools.description: BRAZIL. Computes the municipal ITBI transfer tax (general rate read in the law of 41 cities), the notary deed and the registration (2026 table of 21 states) on a home purchase in one of the 55 cities covered. Missing parts are flagged (lower limit or not computed), never estimated.

reference_value.description: City reference value in reais, if higher than the price.

tools.name: mortgage_payment_br
tools.description: BRAZIL. Monthly payment under the Price system (constant) and the SAC system (falling), total interest, CMN loan-to-value caps; default rate = Banco Central average on new housing loans to individuals (latest month).

tools.name: capital_gains_tax_br
tools.description: BRAZIL. Income tax on the gain from selling a home: non-residents computed in full (15% to 22.5% by band, 25% in a listed low-tax jurisdiction, withheld by the buyer); residents: exemptions tested, tax as an upper limit before the FR1/FR2 reduction factors. Purchases before 1996 not computed.

only_property.description: Resident: only property owned, no sale in five years.

reinvested.description: Resident: amount reinvested in a home in Brazil within 180 days.

tools.name: compare_states_br
tools.description: BRAZIL. One table across the 27 federative units: purchase-costs-capitals, itbi-state-capitals, notary-and-registry-fees, median-value-financed-homes, rented-homes-share, construction-cost-per-m2.

tools.name: guide_br
tools.description: BRAZIL. Finds the Payotte guide answering a question about a home in Brazil — CPF, rural land and beachfront rules for foreigners, ITBI, deeds, mortgages, capital gains, tenancy law, IPTU — and returns its short answer, check date and URL.

query.description: The question or keywords, e.g. "CPF foreigner", "terrenos de marinha".

tools.name: check_professional_br
tools.description: BRAZIL. For a real estate broker (CRECI), property appraiser (CNAI, CREA/CAU), architect or engineer (CAU, CREA), mortgage lender (Banco Central) or property lawyer (OAB): where the reader checks a registration. Payotte lists no Brazilian professional yet, and never lists lawyers or lenders.

trade.description: real estate broker, property appraiser, architect or engineer, mortgage lender, property lawyer.

tools.name: closing_costs_mx
tools.description: MEXICO. Computes the property acquisition tax (ISAI, ISABI, ISTD… set by each municipality or state) and the state's fee to record the deed on a home purchase, from the 2026 laws read, in 54 municipalities (Cancún, Playa del Carmen, Tulum, Puerto Vallarta, Bahía de Banderas, Los Cabos, La Paz, Mazatlán, San Miguel de Allende, Mérida, Guadalajara, Querétaro, Tijuana…). Base = the higher of the price and the appraisal or cadastral value. Others return "not computed" with no figure. Notary fees are not computed.

municipality.description: Municipality or locality, e.g. "Cancún", "Nuevo Vallarta", "Cabo San Lucas", "San Miguel de Allende".

appraisal_or_cadastral_value.description: Appraisal or cadastral value in MXN, if higher than the price.

tools.name: mortgage_payment_mx
tools.description: MEXICO. Monthly payment and total interest of a fixed-rate peso mortgage; default rate = Banco de México average of advertised fixed-rate offers (latest month), with the average CAT and the Banxico target rate.

tools.name: home_prices_mx
tools.description: MEXICO. Sociedad Hipotecaria Federal figures: median and mean appraisal value of homes bought with a mortgage by state (Jan.-June 2026), and the price index change over a year by state or municipality. Prices in pesos exist by state only.

place.description: A Mexican state or municipality, e.g. "Quintana Roo", "Mérida". Empty = national.

tools.name: compare_states_mx
tools.description: MEXICO. One rule or figure compared across the states: acquisition-tax, recording-fee, home-prices, price-change, home-loans, rented-homes, agent-licensing.

tools.name: guide_mx
tools.description: MEXICO. Finds the Payotte guide answering a question about buying (restricted zone, fideicomiso, notary, deed), financing, selling (income tax for residents and non-residents), renting or owning a home in Mexico, and returns its self-contained short answer, check date and URL.

query.description: The question or keywords, e.g. "fideicomiso permit cost", "selling as a non-resident".

tools.name: check_professional_mx
tools.description: MEXICO. For a real estate agent (state licence where one exists), appraiser (SHF register), mortgage lender (CNBV, CONDUSEF), notary (appointed by the state) or real estate lawyer (cédula profesional): where the reader checks. Payotte lists no Mexican professional yet and never lists notaries or lawyers.

trade.description: real estate agent, appraiser, mortgage lender, notary or real estate lawyer.

tools.name: purchase_costs_es
tools.description: SPAIN. Computes transfer tax (ITP) on a resale home, or VAT/IGIC and stamp duty (AJD) on a new home, plus land registry fees and the notary's deed fee, at the general rates of each of the 17 regions, Ceuta and Melilla (official texts read), on the higher of the price and the Catastro reference value.

region.description: Region (English or Spanish name) or a covered city (e.g. "Marbella", "Andalucía").

new_home.description: New home bought from the developer (VAT + AJD) instead of a resale home (ITP).

reference_value.description: Catastro reference value in euros, if known.

tools.name: mortgage_payment_es
tools.description: SPAIN. Monthly payment and total interest of a repayment mortgage; default rate = Banco de España average rate on mortgages over three years (latest month). Also returns the 12-month Euribor.

tools.name: non_resident_tax_es
tools.description: SPAIN. Non-resident income tax (IRNR) for 2026 on the imputed income of a home a non-resident keeps without letting it: 2% (or 1.1%) of the cadastral value, taxed at 24% (19% for EU/EEA residents).

values_revised.description: Municipal cadastral values revised in the last ten years (1.1%).

eu_eea_resident.description: Resident of an EU/EEA state (19%); otherwise 24% (UK, Canada, USA…).

tools.name: house_prices_es
tools.description: SPAIN. Ministry average appraised value per m² (Q2 2026) for 55 cities and the 19 regions, its change over a year, and the INE house price index by region.

place.description: City or region, e.g. "Marbella", "Balearic Islands". Empty = Spain.

tools.name: compare_regions_es
tools.description: SPAIN. One rule compared across the 19 regions: purchase-tax, new-home-taxes, young-buyer-rates, large-family-rates, appraised-values, house-price-index, agent-registers, stressed-market-areas.

tools.name: guide_es
tools.description: SPAIN. Finds the Payotte guide answering a question about buying (including as a foreign or non-resident buyer: NIE, IRNR, 3% withholding, golden visa), financing, selling, renting or owning a home in Spain, and returns its short answer, check date and URL.

tools.name: check_professional_es
tools.description: SPAIN. For a real estate agent (regional registers), property valuer (Banco de España), architect (colegios), mortgage lender (Banco de España) or property lawyer (bar associations): where the reader checks. Payotte lists no Spanish professional yet and never lists lawyers.

trade.description: real estate agent, property valuer, architect, mortgage lender or property lawyer.

tools.name: purchase_costs_de
tools.description: GERMANY. Computes real estate transfer tax (Grunderwerbsteuer) at the rate of each of the 16 states, notary and land registry fees from the GNotKG fee table (in force 1 June 2025), and optionally the land charge for a loan and an agent commission the user gives.

state.description: State (English or German name) or a covered city (e.g. "Bayern", "Munich").

loan_amount.description: Loan secured by a land charge, in euros (optional).

agent_commission_pct.description: Agent commission the buyer pays, % of the price (optional; no legal rate exists).

tools.name: mortgage_payment_de
tools.description: GERMANY. Monthly payment and total interest of an annuity loan; default rate = Bundesbank average effective rate on new housing loans fixed over 5 up to 10 years (latest month). Also returns the other fixation periods.

tools.name: rents_de
tools.description: GERMANY. Average net cold rent per m², owner-occupation and vacancy rates at the 2022 census for the largest cities and the 16 states.

place.description: City or state, e.g. "Leipzig", "Bavaria". Empty = Germany.

tools.name: compare_states_de
tools.description: GERMANY. One rule compared across the 16 states: purchase-tax, first-buyer-aid, property-tax-model, rents-and-ownership, land-value-data.

tools.name: guide_de
tools.description: GERMANY. Finds the Payotte guide answering a question about buying (including as a foreign buyer), financing, selling, renting or owning a home in Germany, and returns its short answer, check date and URL.

tools.name: check_professional_de
tools.description: GERMANY. For a real estate agent (§ 34c GewO permit, no public register), mortgage broker (§ 34i, DIHK register), property valuer (public appointment), architect (state chambers) or notary (public office): where the reader checks. Payotte lists no German firm yet and never lists notaries.

trade.description: real estate agent, mortgage broker, property valuer, architect or notary.

tools.name: purchase_costs_it
tools.description: ITALY. Computes the national purchase taxes: registration tax 9% (2% with prima casa relief, min. €1,000) on the price or the cadastral value (prezzo-valore) plus €50 + €50 on a resale from a private owner; VAT 10% (4% prima casa, 22% luxury A/1, A/8, A/9) plus €200 × 3 on a new build from a builder; optional substitute tax on the mortgage (0.25% / 2%) and an agent commission the user gives. The notary fee is never computed (no tariff).

seller.description: "private" (resale, default) or "builder" (new build sold with VAT).

first_home.description: Prima casa relief (main home, conditions apply).

luxury_category.description: Cadastral category A/1, A/8 or A/9 (excluded from the relief).

cadastral_income.description: Rendita catastale in euros, to tax the cadastral value instead of the price (private seller only, optional).

agent_commission_pct.description: Agent commission the buyer pays, % of the price (optional; no legal rate exists).

tools.name: mortgage_payment_it
tools.description: ITALY. Monthly payment and total interest of a constant-instalment loan; default rate = ECB average agreed rate for Italy on new housing loans fixed over 5 up to 10 years (latest month). Also returns the other fixation periods.

tools.name: home_sales_it
tools.description: ITALY. Home sales (OMI register of the Agenzia delle Entrate) in 2024 and 2025 (provisional), sales per 1,000 residents and population (ISTAT) for the 20 regions and the 20 cities with the most sales.

place.description: City or region, e.g. "Bologna", "Tuscany", "Lombardia". Empty = Italy.

tools.name: compare_regions_it
tools.description: ITALY. One measure compared across the 20 regions (home-sales).

tools.name: guide_it
tools.description: ITALY. Finds the Payotte guide answering a question about buying (including as a foreign buyer), financing, selling, renting, renovating or owning a home in Italy, and returns its short answer, check date and URL.

tools.name: check_professional_it
tools.description: ITALY. For a real estate agent (Registro Imprese / REA), mortgage broker (OAM lists), surveyor (geometri register), architect (Albo Unico Nazionale) or notary (public office, Albo Unico): where the reader checks. Payotte lists no Italian firm yet and never lists notaries.

trade.description: real estate agent, mortgage broker, surveyor, architect or notary.

tools.name: purchase_costs_be
tools.description: BELGIUM. Computes the costs of buying an existing home in Brussels-Capital, Wallonia or Flanders: the Region's registration duty (12.5% / 12% or the sole-home reduced rate and abatements), the notary fees from the legal tariff plus VAT, the estimated other costs, and optionally the mortgage deed. Same figures as the calculator on payotte.com/belgium/purchase-costs (FR: /belgique/frais-achat, NL: /belgie/aankoopkosten).

region.description: Region of the home. Registration duties are regional. May be omitted if municipality is given.

municipality.description: Optional: a municipality Payotte covers (e.g. "Liège", "Gent", "Ixelles"), used to find the Region when region is omitted.

sole_home.description: Sole and own home (you will live there and own no other home). Default true. False = normal rates.

flemish_core_city.description: Flanders only: the home is in a core city (centrumstad) or the Flemish Periphery (Vlaamse Rand). Default false.

loan_amount.description: Optional: mortgage amount in euros, to add the cost of the mortgage deed.

tools.name: borrowing_capacity_be
tools.description: BELGIUM. From a net monthly income, computes the capital a fixed-rate loan allows and the highest home price once the Region's purchase costs are paid. Belgium has no legal debt-to-income rule: the share of income (default 33%) and the rate (default 3.5%) are example assumptions you can change. As on payotte.com/belgium/borrowing-capacity (FR: /belgique/capacite-emprunt, NL: /belgie/leencapaciteit).

net_monthly_income.description: Household net income per month, in euros.

share_of_income_pct.description: Share of that income going to the loan, in percent (default 33).

monthly_credits.description: Other monthly credit repayments, in euros (default 0).

region.description: Region of the home. Registration duties are regional. May be omitted if municipality is given.

municipality.description: Optional: a municipality Payotte covers (e.g. "Liège", "Gent", "Ixelles"), used to find the Region when region is omitted.

sole_home.description: Sole and own home (you will live there and own no other home). Default true. False = normal rates.

tools.name: house_prices_be
tools.description: BELGIUM. Median price of houses and of apartments, with the number of sales, the change over one and ten years and the latest quarters, for a municipality (55 covered: the 19 Brussels municipalities, Wallonian and Flemish cities), a province or a Region. Statbel medians of recorded resale deeds (FPS Finance), no median under 16 sales.

area.description: e.g. "Liège", "Gent", "Ixelles", "Provincie Antwerpen", "Wallonia". "Brussels" = the Region; "Bruxelles" = the City of Brussels.

tools.name: compare_regions_be
tools.description: BELGIUM. The same purchase compared across Brussels-Capital, Wallonia and Flanders: registration duty, notary, other costs, total and its share of the price, with each Region's median house and apartment price (Statbel). Registration duties are regional; the notary tariff is federal.

sole_home.description: Sole and own home (you will live there and own no other home). Default true. False = normal rates.

flemish_core_city.description: Flanders only: the home is in a core city (centrumstad) or the Flemish Periphery (Vlaamse Rand). Default false.

tools.name: guide_be
tools.description: BELGIUM. Finds the Payotte guide answering a question about buying, financing, selling, renting or owning a home in Belgium, in English, French or Dutch, and returns its self-contained short answer, check date and URL (and the same guide in the other languages when it exists). The page URL is returned for citation.

query.description: The question or keywords, e.g. "registration duties Brussels", "droits d'enregistrement", "huurwaarborg".

language.description: Optional: restrict to one language. Omitted = search all three.

tools.name: check_professional_be
tools.description: BELGIUM. For an estate agent, mortgage (credit) broker, notary, land surveyor or EPB/EPC energy assessor: the regulatory body or register, what the title means and where the reader checks it (IPI/BIV, FSMA, notaire.be, the surveyors' Order, the Walloon energy administration). Names no professional.

trade.description: estate agent, mortgage broker, notary, surveyor or EPB assessor (French and Dutch names accepted).

language.description: Language of the page to return (default en).

tools.name: aides_habitation
tools.description: Call this when the user asks which grants, rebates, tax credits or loans they can get to BUY, RENOVATE, SAVE ENERGY, ADAPT a home (seniors, disability), lower PROPERTY TAXES, or BUILD/RENT housing anywhere in Canada. Returns the programs in force for a province (federal + provincial + energy utilities) and, when `ville` is given, that city's municipal programs: amount, status, key conditions, published stacking rule, official page and verification date. ~800 programs, each checked on the agency's official page within the last 30 days; a status the agency does not state is flagged as inferred. Payotte does not confirm eligibility — the user applies to the agency.

province.description: Province or territory, e.g. "Québec", "ON", "British Columbia". Required.

ville.description: City, to add its municipal programs, e.g. "Montréal", "Toronto", "Saskatoon". Optional.

projet.description: acheter (buy), renover (renovate), energie (energy), adapter (accessibility/seniors), taxes (property taxes), construire (new construction/rental). Optional: all projects if omitted.

inclure_fermees.description: Also return programs that are closed. Default false.

lang.description: Language of the labels. Default fr.
